name: poratake
description: Capture, annotate, record, edit, and share on macOS and Windows.
author: Serhii Vecherenko

scripts.build-mac: bun run build-native-mac && bun run package-mac
scripts.package-mac: rm -rf ./dist && rm -rf ./dist-electron && tsc && vite build && electron-builder --mac --universal -p never
scripts.build-mac:local: bun run build-native-mac && rm -rf ./dist && rm -rf ./dist-electron && tsc && vite build && electron-builder --mac --universal -c.mac.identity=null -p never
scripts.build-win: bun run build-native-win && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');fs.rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true});fs.rmSync('dist-electron',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc && vite build && node scripts/package-win.mjs
scripts.build-native-win: bun run build-daemon-win && bun run build-ffmpeg-win && bun run build-whisper-win
scripts.checks: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run test:run && bun run test:daemon-win
